source_note: Server audit and all frozen source hashes checked before subsequent scientific-source deployment; raw six-world records retained locally and on server. Post-run strict-pattern compatibility testing found incomplete one-character physical explanations; see post_run_limitations. Original archived evidence and scores are unchanged.

post_run_limitations.strict_pattern_semantics: Post-run CPU checks confirmed the strict decoder treats JSON schema pattern \S as a full-string match in both auto and required modes; the runtime accepts substring matching. This constrained physical_explanation for submit/save_draft to one non-whitespace character.
post_run_limitations.interpretation: Timely submission and completed numerical evaluation do not establish complete physical explanations. The archived audit does not check this semantic completeness issue.
post_run_limitations.next_version_fix: A transport-schema copy changes the pattern to ^[\s\S]*\S[\s\S]*$ and has been checked with multi-paragraph Chinese/non-empty text. The fix is not part of R09 source.
post_run_limitations.archive_policy: Original submissions, raw records, audit and scores remain unchanged; no explanation backfill or re-evaluation.
